Scope :Standardization in the field of Ayurveda, covering both classical and contemporary aspects of its products, processes and services.The Committee shall focus on, but not be limited to, standardization of terminology and definitions related to Ayurveda; quality, safety, performance requirements and test methods for raw materials and extracts; manufacturing processes, including traditional processing methods and associated quality parameters; Ayurveda pharmaceutical equipment, medical devices and tools; health assessment tools and related equipment used in Ayurveda; Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for Ayurveda treatments and procedures, limited to process standardization, safety requirements and operational aspects ensuring safe use and delivery of therapies; service standards concerning the safe delivery and operational requirements of Ayurveda therapies.This scope does not include clinical decision-making, clinical practice, therapeutic claims, or the clinical application
Standardization in the field of Ayurveda, covering both classical and contemporary aspects of its products, processes and services.
The Committee shall focus on, but not be limited to, standardization of terminology and definitions related to Ayurveda; quality, safety, performance requirements and test methods for raw materials and extracts; manufacturing processes, including traditional processing methods and associated quality parameters; Ayurveda pharmaceutical equipment, medical devices and tools; health assessment tools and related equipment used in Ayurveda; Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for Ayurveda treatments and procedures, limited to process standardization, safety requirements and operational aspects ensuring safe use and delivery of therapies; service standards concerning the safe delivery and operational requirements of Ayurveda therapies.
This scope does not include clinical decision-making, clinical practice, therapeutic claims, or the clinical application
